title: Official signed episcopal decree, 1 January 2019
assessment: Primary church legal document; both pages visually inspected. Quotes 1948 judgment and CDF 20 Nov 2018 letter; regularizes devotion without recognizing alleged phenomena.

title: Bishop Francesco Beschi official letter, 1 January 2019
assessment: Primary church statement; text read. Date, child age, number of alleged appearances, unchanged non constat.

title: Official prayer booklet containing letter and decree
assessment: Official publication. Printed pages 9-11 reproduce decree; not a separate independent investigation.

title: Diocese announcement, 13 February 2019
assessment: Official announcement links original decree/letter. Authorization effective 11 February 2019.

title: Diocesan shrine directory, 30 May 2025
assessment: Official pastoral directory, but imprecise historical wording: says Church never officially pronounced, inconsistent with signed decree. Not evidence of reversal.

title: Marco Roncalli, Corriere Bergamo, 12 November 2013: Bernareggi diary excerpts
assessment: Reputable newspaper reproducing contemporary 20 May-27 July 1944 diary passages. Not original manuscript or entire published edition.

title: Reproduction of Adelaide handwritten diary, introduced as written in 1953
assessment: Retrospective testimony, devotional reproduction. Introduction read; handwritten pages not fully transcribed. Must not label contemporaneous 1944 diary.

title: La luce di Ghiaie devotional portal with Vittorio Villa film embeds
assessment: Host attributes 9.5 mm footage to last four apparition days of May 1944. Attribution verified as claim of host, original reel not authenticated. Film not watched in this pass.

title: Vittorio Villa film upload, part I
assessment: Publicly linked by S08; video fetch failed, actual frames not audited.

title: Vittorio Villa film upload, part II
assessment: Publicly linked by S08; video fetch failed, actual frames not audited.

title: Alberto Lombardoni, I diari a confronto, updated 24 March 2014
assessment: Pro-apparition archival analysis; identifies sisters 1944 questionnaire, Don Italo Duci diary, multiple later Adelaide diary versions. Web text read; download failed. Leads, not authenticated originals.

title: Enrico Caffi article/date lead and reported solar episodes
assessment: Non-scholarly later source: claims L Eco di Bergamo 26 May 1944 Il sole delle Ghiaie and Gazzetta del Popolo 15 July 1944. Originals not obtained; distant testimony and astronomical replies unverified.

title: 1944 postcard photograph, Storylab
assessment: User-uploaded historical image caption: Crimella Milano publisher, G. Meli Bergamo photographer. Caption does not authenticate apparition image.

title: Ghiaie.org early book bibliography
assessment: Strongly partisan devotional bibliography. Lists Cortesi 1944/1945, Cenci 1944, Traini 1944, Cazzamalli 1951. Linked Cortesi PDFs returned 404.

title: Pietro Martini, Ferdinando Cazzamalli (1887-1958), Insula Fulcheria 2018, pp 309-318
assessment: Historical journal hosted by Comune Crema; verifies medical background including Pavia medical graduation and Como psychiatric hospital role. Public web text read; local curl failed certificate validation.

title: Lanfranchi newspaper collection inventory
assessment: Archive finding aid lists L Eco di Bergamo 22 May 1944 and I fatti delle Ghiaie (undated). Does not prove issue content; not original article.

title: Universita Cattolica institutional history
assessment: University confirms Gemelli as founder. His case-specific report still needs original recovery.

title: Bergamo civic natural-history museum institutional biography of Enrico Caffi
assessment: Museum identifies Caffi as first director, Pavia natural sciences graduate, serving through 1947. Birth year in page conflicts with other biographies; not used.

title: Corriere 26 August 2014 on disputed retraction and no reopening
assessment: Later reporting, not original retraction or John XXIII letter. Recovery target only.

title: La luce di Ghiaie narrative of investigations
assessment: Partisan pro-apparition account; names Gemelli, Sidlauskaite, Cortesi and Cazzamalli. Allegations of coercion/invasive examinations need originals and contextual audit.
